question: A, B and C can do a work in 5 days,6 days and 10 days, respectively. Working together, in how many days will they finish the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do the work in 5 days.

B can do the work in 6 days.

C can do the work in 10 days.

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

⇒ One day work of A = 1/5 units

⇒ One day work of B = 1/6 units

⇒ One day work of C = 1/10 units

Total Work of A B and C = (1/5) + (1/6) + (1/10)

Total Work = (6 + 5 + 3)/30

Total Work = 14/30 = 7/15 units

A B and C can complete the work in 15/7 days

**∴ They will finish the same work in 15/7 or 2{{1} over 7}. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**
